description:
Map financial instrument identifiers between different ID systems using
        Bloomberg's OpenFIGI service. Converts between ticker symbols, ISINs,
        CUSIPs, and FIGIs in a single call.

        Use this tool when:
        - You have a ticker and need the ISIN or CUSIP (or vice versa)
        - You are normalizing instrument IDs when combining data from EDGAR,
          Yahoo Finance, and other sources that use different ID schemes
        - You need to identify what exchange a security trades on

        Supported idType values:
        - 'TICKER': Stock ticker symbol (e.g. 'AAPL')
        - 'ID_ISIN': ISIN (e.g. 'US0378331005')
        - 'ID_CUSIP': CUSIP (e.g. '037833100')
        - 'ID_FIGI': Bloomberg FIGI

        Include 'exchCode': 'US' to target US exchanges for ticker lookups.

        Source: Bloomberg OpenFIGI API. No API key required (optional key raises rate limits).

        When provided, the tool will load the full dataset directly from the cache folder instead of
        re-executing the query against the database. Pass this when the user is asking a follow-up
        question or a different grouping/filter on data that was already fetched. 
        Also, use this, when one tool output is an input for another tool.

wholesaler_ids.description:
List of wholesaler IDs or names to filter results by the internal fin user
        who owns or manages the data. If names are provided instead of IDs, the system will automatically
        resolve them to their corresponding USER_IDs before applying the filter.
        
        In fin, users are assigned one of three roles:
        - Wholesaler: A field-level sales representative responsible for a specific territory, channel,
        or book of accounts. This is the most granular user type. Most sales data, advisor relationships,
        and touchpoints in fin are owned at the wholesaler level.
        - Manager: Oversees a team of Wholesalers, typically organized by territory or sales channel
        (e.g., Regional Manager, Channel Manager). Filtering by a Manager ID will scope results
        to that Manager's purview across their team.
        - Executive: C-suite level users (e.g., CEO, CFO, COO) at the asset manager / fund company
        level (e.g., PIMCO, MetLife, BlackRock). Executives have the broadest visibility and their
        ID represents an org-wide scope.

        Accepts either:
        - User IDs directly (e.g., ['WS001', 'MGR045'])
        - Full or partial user names (e.g., ['John Smith', 'Sarah']) — these will be resolved to IDs
        - A mix of both (e.g., ['WS001', 'Sarah Connor'])

        If omitted, data is returned based on the authenticated user's role and their default data scope.
        Examples: ['WS001'], ['WS001', 'MGR045'], ['John Smith'], ['John Smith', 'WS002']
wholesaler_ids.title: Wholesaler Ids
